inputs.text: Harry Wait was convicted of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge after requesting ballots for Robin Vos and Cory Mason without consent, though he was acquitted of another identity theft count. But he said he was demonstrating that the registration system could be exploited. The bigger issue is that institutions benefit when testing the system brings serious consequences and scrutiny itself is treated as the threat. People focus on the charges and dismiss the group as purveyors of “false election claims,” making an example of someone who probed the machinery.
